scripts.test:db: set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; RUN_DB_TESTS=1 RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:probes: set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; RUN_LIVE_PROBES=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/lib/rails/increase
scripts.test:livefire: set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; LIVEFIRE=1 RUN_DB_TESTS=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=300000 --hookTimeout=300000 src/test/livefire src/lib/chaos/chaos.livefire.test.ts
scripts.test:optin: set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; RUN_DB_TESTS=1 RUN_LITHIC_TESTS=1 RUN_POT_DEMO=1 EVENTS_LIVE=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/lib/team src/lib/pots src/lib/events
scripts.test:submission:
set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env; set +a; rc=0; for s in test test:db test:probes test:livefire; do printf '
======== pnpm %s ========
' "$s"; pnpm run "$s" || rc=1; done; printf '
======== node scripts/dbcheck.mjs ========
(4 failures are the deliberate/red-on-arrival findings; READ them, do not count them)
'; node scripts/dbcheck.mjs; printf '
======== node scripts/dbcheck.mjs --prove ========
(must read: EVERY invariant view is covered -- the fraction is printed, read it)
'; node scripts/dbcheck.mjs --prove; exit $rc
